summary: Frontend-only SEO + smoke regression sweep on Safe Ride. Ran 75+ assertions across homepage, language toggle, 3 location pages (einsiedeln, waedenswil, chur), ablauf, vku, blog list + blog post, buchung, partner, impressum, datenschutz, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, plus regression checks (CTA scroll, admin login, WhatsApp FAB). All SEO requirements satisfied: per-page <title>, meta description, canonical, og:title/desc/image/url/locale, twitter:card, 3 hreflang alternates, and the correct JSON-LD types on each page (LocalBusiness + FAQPage on home; +BreadcrumbList +second LocalBusiness on locations; HowTo on ablauf; Course on VKU; Blog on /blog; BlogPosting+BreadcrumbList on blog post; ItemList(Product offers) on buchung; Organization with subOrganization on partner). Language toggle correctly mutates <html lang>, <title> and meta description for both EN and back to DE. Sitemap returns valid XML with all 11 locations + homepage + ablauf + vku + impressum + datenschutz + blog + buchung + partner = 19 URLs. Net: 0 real SEO regressions, 0 real functional regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: INFO (not a bug): robots.txt served by the preview environment is prepended with a Cloudflare 'managed content' block that Disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc. The app's own robots.txt directives (allowing those AI crawlers) appear AFTER. Per robots.txt spec the first matching User-agent block wins, so the app-level 'Allow' directives for AI crawlers are effectively neutralised in the preview/Emergent deployment by Cloudflare. This is platform behaviour, not a code bug; in production on www.fahrschule-saferide.ch the Cloudflare block may not exist or may be configurable. Worth flagging to the user.

INFO: Sitemap is served correctly under the current preview origin (/api/sitemap.xml) but robots.txt advertises Sitemap as https://www.fahrschule-saferide.ch/api/sitemap.xml (the production hostname). This is intentional and correct for production but means crawlers hitting the preview won't fetch the preview sitemap from the preview robots. No action needed unless preview is meant to be indexed.
Seo.jsx is well-isolated, uses absolute og:image fallback, and reactively switches lang/title/description on locale change — clean.
BlogPost og:image correctly switches to article images (verified: pexels URL, absolute https).

Sitemap is at /api/sitemap.xml (NOT /sitemap.xml). robots.txt at /robots.txt is partially overridden by Cloudflare-managed prelude in preview env.
